Feature Specification: Bill help

The end in mind

Students stay housed & in school, because a missed bill never becomes a shut‑off.

User Scenarios & Testing

User Story 1 - See a short month coming (Priority: P1)

Acceptance Scenarios:

  1. Given rent of $900 and $700 expected, When the student opens Today, Then a warning shows the $200 gap.
  2. Given nothing due, When the student opens Today, Then no warning shows.

Requirements

  • FR-001: The system MUST warn before the first of the month.
  • FR-002: Reminders MUST stop once a bill is paid. [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: is a receipt needed?]
SettingDefault
LanguageEnglish | Spanish
Scenario: Quiet hours
  Given quiet hours from 9pm to 8am
  When a reminder falls at 10pm
  Then it is sent at 8am

Engineering notes

  • Use the student database already in place, until the new records system is live
